headline: The Atom feeds intel to Deathstroke
post:
Ray Palmer is taking a surprisingly dark path in current comics. According to Screen Rant, the shrinking hero has secretly spent months giving information to Deathstroke because of growing frustration with team policies. 

Things get even more intense when the Atom confronts Slade Wilson in "Deathstroke: The Terminator #9" after a dispute over a dead Green Lantern found in a trunk. Instead of playing the usual background role, Palmer actually defeats Slade in hand-to-hand combat before fleeing the scene.

It is fascinating to see DC finally bring the classic hero into a much more unpredictable and morally complex spotlight. ⚛️

#TheAtom #DCComics #Deathstroke
original_title: DC Officially Confirms Return Of Iconic Justice League Hero

headline: DNX #5 reveals Cyclops' secret spatial awareness
post:
Hey mutant fans! Scott Summers just showcased a hidden skill during his clash with Beast in the DNX crossover event. According to Screen Rant, when his visor gets shattered and leaves him fighting blind, the X-Men leader relies on an impressive "spatial awareness" to navigate. 

Instead of just depending on intense training, this trick connects directly to his secondary mutant gifts. Scott possesses a superhuman instinct for range and trajectory, which helps him build a detailed mental map of any room instantly. 

As team leader, he trains himself this way so he never becomes a liability to his fellow heroes. You can grab DNX #5 from Marvel Comics right now to see the action unfold. 💥

What is your favorite Cyclops moment in comics?

#XMen #Cyclops #MarvelComics
original_title: X-Men Officially Confirms Cyclops' Permanent New Superpower, In Main Continuity
